canonical_title: Automatic take-off system or automatic landing system data
subject_group: DATA DISPLAYED IN THE UAS CONTROL STATION

versions.title_at_revision: Automatic take-off system or automatic landing system data
versions.text:
For UAV equipped with an automatic take-off system or an automatic landing system or both, the following data must be continuously displayed to the UAV crew during the respective flight phases in compliance with USAR.1490 (d)
(a) the UAV flightpath,
(b) the deviation between the UAV flightpath and the planned flightpath. For landing the standard slope is as defined in USAR.75.
